item.tib: gshen rab bka' 'bum chen po'i dkar chags srid pa'i sgron ma gzhon nu'i 'khri shing phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan
item.coloph: de ltar thams cad mkhyen pa chen po dmu sras rgyud pa dang bcas pa yis mdo rgyud gangs can du 'gyur ro cog ji snyed pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa gshen rab bka' 'bum dkar chag rtsoms (rtsom) pa'i gtam srid pa'i sgron me gzhon nu'i 'khri shing phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba mtha' rgyas kyi bar skabs tshigs su bcad pa zhang zhung gi mkhas pa gtsang gshen snyan ngags kyis (ngag gi) lugs la tshig rkyang brgyad bcu 'phel yod pa bkra shis pa po skye 'gro'i legs bshad gtam gyi 'grel 'di ni/ grub thob spa yi gdung las sku 'khrungs pa'i mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan can nyi ma 'bum gsal dang nam mkha' sgron gsal gnyis kyi rgya rings lo hor gyi yul nas gsung gis bskur (bskul) pa la brtson lhur blangs te/ mkhas shing grub pa'i khyab bdag skyes bu bdun gyis gsung las skyes pa slob 'bang ('bangs) yongs gi (kyi) thal shal ba/ rig 'dzin slob dpon chen po yab sras kyi lung gis sbas mngon ming lnga 'bod pa/ ming dngos mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa'am/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal zhes bgyis pa bdag cag gi ston pa rnam mkhyen rgyal ba gshen rab dgongs pa zhi dbyings su gnas pa'i tshul bstan nas/ bsgrangs (bgrang) bya 'das pa me mo phag gi lo chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs bcom ldan thub pa'i dpang pos tshes bzhi chos 'khor bskor ba dang tshes bco lnga lhums su zhugs kyi bar du/ rigs bzhi'i nang tshan rin chen rigs kyis (kyi) gnas mchog bam brag brtsegs pa rin chen 'bar ba'i mthil mtsho steng bde ldan khrod kyis (kyi) 'og min 'chi med g.yung drung bkod pa'i khang bzang du bris pa dge legs su gyur cig tha tshan mu tsug smar ro//
